description: The shared fault library. Every engine uses these definitions unless it ships an engines/<engine-id>/faults.json of its own. The coefficients are the ones that were written into simulation/fault_injector.py as an if/elif chain; they are reproduced here exactly, not re-derived.

provenance.note: SIH26054 names the failure modes to cover; the severity coefficients below are this project's calibration of how far each mode moves the engine, not published manufacturer data.

faults.name: Lean mixture, cylinder 3
faults.description: Reduced fuel trim on one cylinder. The charge burns lean and late, which raises that cylinder's exhaust gas temperature while its neighbours stay nominal.

faults.name: Rich mixture, cylinder 1
faults.description: Excess fuel on cylinder 1. Evaporative cooling drops that cylinder's exhaust gas temperature and fuel consumption rises.

faults.name: Cooling loss, cylinder 2
faults.description: Baffle or cooling airflow restriction on cylinder 2. Head temperature climbs while its exhaust temperature stays close to nominal, which is what separates this from a mixture fault.

faults.name: Oil pressure loss
faults.description: Pump relief valve leak or gallery loss. Delivered oil pressure falls away from what the model expects at that speed and temperature.

faults.name: Turbo boost deficiency
faults.description: Wastegate stuck open or compressor blade erosion. The engine cannot hold its rated manifold pressure, and the shortfall grows with altitude.

faults.name: Misfire and timing jitter
faults.description: Injection or ignition timing flutter, or a valve failing to seat. Shaft speed becomes unsteady and vibration rises.

faults.name: Bearing wear
faults.description: Mechanical bearing degradation. Second-order vibration is amplified and friction rises with it.

faults.name: EGT probe failure, cylinder 3
faults.description: The cylinder 3 exhaust thermocouple fails open and reads close to ambient. The engine itself is healthy, and separating this from a real cylinder fault is the point of the physics cross-check.
faults.severity_note: The probe is either open or it is not, so the severity in the request has no effect. Verified: a run at 1.0 and a run at 0.5 produce identical telemetry.

faults.name: Bus voltage sag
faults.description: Alternator regulator degradation. The avionics bus sags under load, which is an airframe-level symptom rather than an engine one.
